title: The Freiburg monosyllable test in noise depending on age
summary: Ziel der vorliegenden Studie ist es, das Sprachverstehen unter Störschallbedingungen anhand des Freiburger Sprachtests systematisch zu untersuchen und dabei den Einfluss des Lebensalters sowie den Schweregrad der Schwerhörigkeit differenziert zu analysieren. Insbesondere soll geklärt werden, inwieweit altersbedingte Veränderungen der peripheren und zentralen Hörverarbeitung das Sprachverstehen in geräuschvollen Situationen beeinträchtigen.

interventions.name:
The study will be conducted at the audiology department of the ENT clinic at St. Elisabeth Hospital Hohenlind in Cologne. Participation is voluntary and requires written consent in accordance with the GDPR and ethical standards.

Total duration per participant: approx. 60–90 minutes

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age 18 or older
- Capacity to consent and written consent to participate in the study after receiving detailed information
- Native German speaker
- No relevant noise exposure (>85 dB(A)) within the last 24 hours before the start of the test
- Normal hearing according to WHO classification (classification is determined by audiometry)
Exclusion criteria:
- Central nervous system disorders affecting cognition
- Retrocochlear disorders
- Early stages of conductive hearing loss despite normal hearing (see above)
- Noise exposure >85dB(A) in the preceding 24 hours
- Non-native speakers
